classification.difficultyReason: Read the right-angle marker, add it to 30°, then see that x is vertically opposite that combined angle. Two relationships are chained, with no algebra.

answer.worked:
Angles in the upper-right sector add to $30^\circ+90^\circ$. Vertically opposite angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}x&=30^\circ+90^\circ\\x&=120^\circ\end{align*}$$
